title: Toll Road Texts
intro: Ten texts, one minute. Your phone has been busy.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Final notice: you owe $3 in unpaid tolls. Pay now to avoid a $10 fine: tarvo-tollpay.live/pay
cards.why: You get a text out of the blue demanding payment through a link. Toll agencies do not collect this way.

cards.text: Your monthly statement is ready. Open the Tarvo Toll app to view it. No action needed.
cards.why: It asks for nothing and sends you to the app you already installed.

cards.text: Your parcel is held. Pay $1 redelivery: parcelo-pay.help
cards.why: An unexpected parcel text with a fee and a link: classic.

cards.text: Orrin: your login code is 551907. Never share this code with anyone, including Orrin staff.
cards.why: You just tried to log in, and the text itself warns you never to share the code.

cards.text: Your toll account is suspended. Update your card at tarvo-secure.net within 30 minutes.
cards.why: A deadline, a threat and a look-alike link, all in one text.

cards.text: Your order #48213 has shipped. Track it in your Meridu account.
cards.why: You ordered it yourself, it asks for nothing, and it sends you to your account.

cards.text: Your phone is blocked for unpaid charges. Pay now: vantel-unlock.co/pay
cards.why: Your phone company does not text a link to pay or unlock. Open its app or check your bill.

cards.text: Running late for the road trip, save me a seat 😅
cards.why: A friend you know, asking for nothing.

cards.text: You have an unpaid road fine of $20. Pay within 24h or your licence will be suspended: roadfines-pay.site
cards.why: A threat and a link, with a payment page that is not an official address.

cards.text: Your toll tag balance is low. Top up in the Tarvo Toll app or at tarvo.app.
cards.why: No link to click: it points you to the app and to the real site you already know.

golden_rule: A text that demands payment through a link is a trap. Check on the official app or website you already know.

quick_check.q: A text says you owe $3 in tolls and must pay through a link. You do not use toll roads. What do you do?

options.text: Do not click. Check with the toll agency using contact details you already know, then report and delete the text
Click the link but do not enter your card

quick_check.explain: The small amount is bait. Real agencies send bills through channels you already know.
